Coffee where it grows. ✨

Drive up into the Blue Mountains and taste it at the source.

Rent a car and go see it for yourself.

Wind up through cool, misty hills to coffee farms and big views over Kingston.

Getting there: Pick up at Norman Manley or our Kingston offices. Allow an hour or more up, and take the winding roads slowly.

Taste Blue Mountain coffee where it grows, then come back down for dinner in Kingston.

A south coast day in 3 stops 🗺️

1. Treasure Beach: Fishing villages, fresh fish and calm. The south coast at its slowest.
2. Lover's Leap: Stand on the cliff and look out over the south coast.
3. Bamboo Avenue: Drive under a tunnel of arching bamboo. Windows down, music on.

Pick up at MBJ and head south. Allow about 2 hours.
